channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI model releases and leading agent updates, scored by rules from 6 sources. Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: LangChain Raises $300M Series C at $3B Valuation
item.description: LangChain raised $300M in new funding to help companies own their agent capabilities through LangSmith.

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: OpenAI expanded its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program, giving 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.

item.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
item.description: To fight online child sexual exploitation and abuse, OpenAI introduced new tooling, hands-on guidance, and partner programs aimed at prevention, detection, and response.

item.title: From tasks to goals
item.description: LangChain is moving agents from doing only assigned tasks toward pursuing open-ended goals on their own.

item.title: Goal Engineering
item.description: Future agents should take on open-ended goals and drive them to completion, and LangChain calls this approach goal engineering.

item.title: New context engineering challenges in late 2026
item.description: LangChain's CEO shares the biggest engineering challenges in context management as proactive agents emerge.

item.title: Why we rebuilt LangSmith around the agent
item.description: LangSmith now centers on a single agent record, so building, running, improving and governing agents all happen in one place.

item.title: More ways to move care forward with ChatGPT for Healthcare
item.description: The update adds computer-use agents, better clinical answers and new healthcare plugins so ChatGPT can do real work inside medical workflows.

item.title: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI
item.description: OpenAI will work alongside NATO and allied cyber teams, giving vetted defenders a hand in hunting flaws, checking patches, and keeping critical infrastructure safe.

item.title: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
item.description: OpenAI is partnering with Chile's government to help public agencies build AI skills and support local startups building AI applications.

item.title: Science at the Frontier: How scientists use ChatGPT
item.description: OpenAI surveyed more than 1,800 scientists about their daily use, showing how AI is changing research workflows, productivity and expectations for discovery.

item.title: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
item.description: LVMH's media arm is teaming up with OpenAI to back journalism with AI and put its publications within easier reach through ChatGPT.

item.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
item.description: OpenAI is bringing computer-use agents that operate software directly into healthcare settings, helping medical teams handle routine system tasks so they can spend more time with patients.

item.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
item.description: The post puts forward one possible nonperturbative lattice definition for the Standard Model and shows how GPT-6 Astra helped turn the concept into a rigorous proof.

item.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
item.description: Hugging Face and OpenRouter have joined forces to make open-weight models easy to run, lowering the barrier to using open models.

item.title: Our first phase of embedded assessments
item.description: OpenAI has kicked off its first round of embedded evaluations, with Apollo Research, METR, Transluce, and Goodfire independently assessing how models line up on alignment, safeguards, and monitoring.

item.title: The King’s Trust and OpenAI launch £1m partnership
item.description: A £1m partnership between The King's Trust and OpenAI aims to equip as many as 25,000 young people in the UK with hands-on AI skills for the workplace.

item.title: At Holiday Extras, dots get to work before anyone asks
item.description: At Holiday Extras, OpenAI's dots push out launch reports on their own, point out issues that might slip by, and even talk through upcoming meetings during the commute.

item.title: Our new blog for science
item.description: OpenAI's new science blog carries fresh discoveries, usable methods, and researchers' own stories of pushing science forward with AI.

item.title: New Ask Maps features to help with holiday travel and prep
item.description: Google has added holiday-travel features to Maps' Ask Maps to help users plan festive trips and preparations more easily.
